To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
work ability in mid-life predicts disability severity 28 years later among middle-aged Finnish municipal employees, with a graded prevalence of disability severity according to work ability.
work ability in mid life predicts disability severity in old age.
lower work ability in mid life predicts higher disability severity in old age.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of work ability as a determinant for disability severity in old age, and the results suggest that work ability in mid-life may be an important determinant of disability severity in later life, and therefore, it should be included in the risk assessment of disability in old age.
work ability as a determinant for old age disability severity.
the role of work ability in the transition to disability later in life.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the better the work ability, the better the old age disability severity.
the demands made by work in midlife relative to individual resources are important predictors of disability in old age.
work ability is a determinant of disability in activities of daily living.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
work ability in mid-life predicts old age disability severity, and that the demands made by work relative to individual work resources in midlife are important for well-being in later life.
work ability is a strong predictor of future disability severity, and that it is a key target for interventions aiming to reduce disability among middle-aged employees.
work ability in mid-life is an important determinant of disability severity in old age.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to consider work ability in mid- to late life as a determinant of disability in old age.
the demands made by work in midlife relative to individual resources predict well-being in later life.
the work ability of middle-aged employees should be considered in order to promote their health and well-being later in life.
